fields.description: First name of the athlete on a club activity (ClubActivity.athlete.firstname). ANONYMIZED (first name only, no athlete id). Own clubs only. Planned (own_club_full).
Last initial of the athlete on a club activity (ClubActivity.athlete.lastname, e.g. 'S.'). ANONYMIZED, no athlete id. Own clubs only. Planned (own_club_full).
Distance of a club activity in meters (ClubActivity.distance). Own clubs only, anonymized feed. Planned (own_club_full).
Elapsed time of a club activity in seconds (ClubActivity.elapsed_time). Own clubs only, anonymized feed. Planned (own_club_full).
Moving time of a club activity in seconds (ClubActivity.moving_time). Own clubs only, anonymized feed. Planned (own_club_full).
Name of a club activity (ClubActivity.name), from GET /clubs/{id}/activities. Own clubs only (membership-gated); anonymized feed with no stable primary key. Planned (own_club_full).
Sport type of a club activity (ClubActivity.sport_type). Own clubs only, anonymized feed. Planned (own_club_full).
Total elevation gain of a club activity in meters (ClubActivity.total_elevation_gain). Own clubs only, anonymized feed. Planned (own_club_full).
Array of activity types supported by the club (DetailedClub.activity_types). Planned.
Whether the authenticated athlete is an admin of this club (DetailedClub.admin). Own clubs only. Planned.

Connected athlete id (GET /athlete -> DetailedAthlete.id). Used ONLY to key the connection identity; never extracted into snapshot rows. Note: club member/activity feeds are anonymized and expose NO athlete id, so the connection is keyed here, not on feed athletes. Planned.
Club city (DetailedClub.city). Free-form location string; NOT the vocabulary-governed GA4 country/device dimension (renamed club_* on purpose to avoid vocabulary collision).
Club country (DetailedClub.country). Free-form location string (NOT an ISO-3166 code); renamed club_country to avoid colliding with the vocabulary-governed 'country' dimension.

Strava club unique identifier (DetailedClub.id). The snapshot grain key. Competitor club ids are supplied as per-project config (resolved once from strava.com/clubs/<slug>); own club ids come from GET /athlete/clubs discovery.
Club display name (DetailedClub.name).
Club state/region (DetailedClub.state). Free-form location string.
Club type (DetailedClub.club_type). Planned.
Club vanity URL slug (DetailedClub.url).
URL of the club large cover photo (~1185x580). Media asset. Planned.
URL of the club small cover photo (~360x176). Media asset. Planned.

Snapshot date (YYYY-MM-DD) STAMPED at extraction time. Strava's Clubs API returns no date field of its own; every club object is a point-in-time snapshot, so the connector stamps the pull's UTC date. This is the time grain of the snapshot fact (one row per club per snapshot date).
Club description text (DetailedClub.description). Planned.
Whether the club is featured (DetailedClub.featured). Cataloged, not extracted by v1 profiles (planned).
Number of accounts the club follows, at the moment of the snapshot. Non-additive point-in-time LEVEL (aggregation_rule=latest, non_additive), same discipline as member_count.

STAMPED by the connector: true when the snapshotted club is one the connected athlete belongs to (from GET /athlete/clubs discovery), false when it is a config-supplied competitor club. Lets the mart separate own vs competitor series.

Whether the club is private (DetailedClub.private). A private competitor club is unreachable by a non-member (GET /clubs/{id} returns 404); such an id is skipped with an alert, never a fabricated zero.
Whether the club is verified (DetailedClub.verified).

Total number of club members at the moment of the snapshot. THE key competitive metric. Non-additive point-in-time LEVEL (aggregation_rule=latest, non_additive): never summed across snapshot dates or across clubs; the growth trend is derived downstream as member_count(t) - member_count(t-1), null on the first snapshot. Strava returns no history (DetailedClub is a current-value snapshot), so the series exists only from first connection onward.
First name of a club member (ClubAthlete.firstname), from GET /clubs/{id}/members. ANONYMIZED (first name only, no athlete id). Own clubs only (membership-gated). Planned (own_club_full).
Whether a club member is an admin (ClubAthlete.admin), from GET /clubs/{id}/members or /admins. Own clubs only. Planned (own_club_full).
Whether a club member is the owner (ClubAthlete.owner). Own clubs only. Planned (own_club_full).
Last initial of a club member (ClubAthlete.lastname). ANONYMIZED, no athlete id. Own clubs only. Planned (own_club_full).
Membership status of a club member: 'member' or 'pending' (ClubAthlete.member/membership; capture whichever the live API returns). Own clubs only. Planned (own_club_full).
Authenticated athlete's membership status relative to this club: 'member' or 'pending' (DetailedClub.membership/member). Only meaningful for own clubs. Planned.
Whether the authenticated athlete owns this club (DetailedClub.owner). Own clubs only. Planned.
Number of posts in the club (present on some DetailedClub responses). Non-additive point-in-time level. Cataloged, not extracted by the v1 profiles (planned).
URL of the club large profile image. Media asset. Planned.
URL of the club 60x60 profile image. Media asset. Planned.
Strava resource detail level (3=detailed). Structural metadata, not analytical. Planned.
Club primary sport type (DetailedClub.sport_type): cycling / running / triathlon / other.
